set.body: Replace the obsolete dense weights-times-atoms benchmark with the real additive streamed cross-Gram lowering, including relation extraction, atom formation, sparse contraction, coherent accumulation, output storage, and measured live temporaries. Rerun isolated-process RSS/allocation scenarios until the conservative plan covers representative cold and warm executions without hiding baseline or unmeasured external storage. Completion requires versioned evidence and an explicit pass/fail gate for the sequential compiler epic.
set.title: Rebenchmark the actual streamed sparse kernel and recalibrate memory bounds
